patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a generous maximum width, creating a focused reading and interaction area, while some visual elements like the image grid span full-width.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with an extremely large, bold sans-serif heading for the hero, contrasting with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for navigation and section titles.
A high-contrast, nearly monochrome palette dominates, using off-white backgrounds and dark grey/black for all text and primary interactive elements, creating a clean and minimal aesthetic.

The primary navigation and logo are contained within a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, while a large, full-width grid of polaroid-style images scrolls past as a continuous visual element.
A distinctive full-width, scrollable grid of polaroid-style images serves as a prominent visual section, breaking up the text-heavy hero and product listings.

technique_notes: The main navigation and logo are contained within a sticky header element that maintains its position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing continuous access to site navigation.

A large, full-width grid of images is implemented as a continuous scrolling element, creating an immersive visual experience that scrolls independently of the sticky header and reveals the content below it.
Product listings are presented as individual cards with a subtle border and shadow, arranged in a responsive grid that adapts to screen size, each containing an image, title, and price/status.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold hero heading (~3-4x body) with a clean, modern sans-serif, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample horizontal padding for centered content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the expansive, full-width grid of polaroid-style images that acts as a dynamic, scrollable visual element, creating a sense of community and activity without being a traditional hero image or background. It's an engaging way to showcase user-generated content or a brand's human element.
